title: FloodGuard Tariff Table: Layer Share for High Building Limits
content:
FloodGuard Private Flood Policy — layer share applied to the annual premium change of a building limit increase.

**Rule.** The layer share applied to the annual premium change is 0.70 when the new building limit is above USD 500000; 0.85 when the new limit is above USD 300000 but not above USD 500000; and the whole annual premium change otherwise.

**Record read.** The new building limit recorded on the most recently requested building limit-increase entry of the policy.

| New building limit on the limit-increase entry | Layer share of the annual premium change |
|---|---|
| above 500000 | 0.70 (70 percent) |
| above 300000, up to and including 500000 | 0.85 (85 percent) |
| 300000 or less | the whole annual premium change |

**The two band lines.** Each line is crossed only when the new limit is above it:

- a new limit of exactly 500000 takes 0.85, and a new limit of 505000 takes 0.70;
- a new limit of exactly 300000 takes the whole annual premium change, and a new limit of 305000 takes 0.85.

**Hypothetical examples** (annual premium change 400.00 in each):

- New building limit 750000: 0.70 of 400.00, which is 280.00.
- New building limit 450000: 0.85 of 400.00, which is 340.00.
- New building limit 250000: the whole 400.00.
